ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image there are four eye diagrams labeled A, B, C, and D: A is at the upper left, B is at the upper right, C is at the lower left, and D is at the lower right. A's eye diagram has obvious trace overlap and vertical closure near the center; B's central sampling region has a larger eye opening; although C has more traces and crossings, the central eye opening is still clearer than A; D has thicker traces and a strong sense of noise, but its main manifestation is more like amplitude noise/dense traces, rather than the most obvious intersymbol-interference closure at the optimal sampling instant. When reasoning, take the optimal sampling instant near the center of the eye diagram, and compare the size of the vertical opening of the eye there. The more severe the intersymbol interference, the more the traces at the optimal sampling point intrude into the decision region, and the more closed the eye opening is. Among the four figures, A has the most obvious vertical closure and overlap at the central sampling position, so the most apparent intersymbol interference corresponds to graph A.

raw_record.question_text: Which eye diagram shown in the image has the most apparent intersymbol interference at the optimal sampling time?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as four labeled eye diagrams A–D. For each diagram, locate the optimal sampling instant near the center of the eye and compare how open the eye is vertically there. Identify the diagram whose traces intrude most into the decision region and whose eye is most closed at that sampling instant. The upper-left diagram A shows the most apparent vertical closure/overlap at the sampling point compared with B, C, and D, so select graph A.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中有四个标注为 A、B、C、D 的眼图：A 位于左上，B 位于右上，C 位于左下，D 位于右下。A 的眼图在中心附近有明显的轨迹重叠和垂直闭合；B 的中心采样区域眼开口较大；C 虽然有较多轨迹和交叉，但中心眼开口仍比 A 更清楚；D 轨迹较厚、噪声感强，但其主要表现更像幅度噪声/密集轨迹，而不是在最佳采样时刻最明显的码间干扰闭合。推理时，把最佳采样时刻取在眼图中心附近，并比较该处眼睛的垂直开口大小。码间干扰越严重，最佳采样点处的轨迹越侵入判决区域，眼开口越闭合。四幅图中，A 在中心采样位置的垂直闭合和重叠最明显，因此最 apparent intersymbol interference 对应 graph A。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the standard eye-opening/vertical-sample-spread criterion directly on the four labeled plots; no alternative measurements are needed for this mostly single-route visual identification task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the 2×2 layout and labels: A is the upper-left eye diagram, B upper-right, C lower-left, D lower-right. Visually compare the eye opening and trace overlap at the central/optimal sampling region in each labeled diagram.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording to focus specifically on 'most apparent intersymbol interference' and 'at the optimal sampling time,' rather than judging overall darkness or noise away from the sampling instant.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In an eye diagram, intersymbol interference at the optimal sampling time is indicated by vertical closure or large spread of the possible signal levels at the sampling instant; the most ISI corresponds to the least clean eye opening at that time.
